LanguageData.ARIO_RelocateDescription: Choose a new world-map tile for this holding. Costs {0} silver from its delivery settlement. Existing maps, active defense, deployed levies and incoming parties prevent relocation.
LanguageData.ARIO_RelocateConfirm: Relocate {0} to tile {1} for {2} silver from {3}? The holding keeps its people, upgrades, equipment, tax balances and timers.

LanguageData.ARIO_RelocateHasMap: Evacuate and close the holding's generated map before relocating.
LanguageData.ARIO_RelocateDefense: Finish the holding's defense before relocating.
LanguageData.ARIO_RelocateLevies: Recall the holding's deployed levies before relocating.
LanguageData.ARIO_RelocateParty: Wait for the holding's incoming parties or reserved agreements to finish.
LanguageData.ARIO_RelocatePayer: The delivery settlement must have a loaded player home map.
LanguageData.ARIO_RelocateLand: Choose a valid land tile on the same world layer.
LanguageData.ARIO_RelocateSameTile: The holding is already on that tile.
LanguageData.ARIO_RelocateTooFar: Choose a tile two or three tiles from the delivery settlement.
LanguageData.ARIO_RelocateOccupied: This tile is unsuitable, occupied or reserved.
LanguageData.ARIO_RelocateStale: The holding changed. Select it again to relocate.
